defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cling
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature leaves the trapjaw tangle's space

Effect The swarm takes 1d6 Untyped Damage damage as individual traps cling to the creature and continue chewing, dealing 2d10 Persistent,slashing Damage damage. High winds or electricity damage reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage by 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging trapjaws.

offensiveAbilities.name: Snapping Jaws
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d10 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw). Creatures that fail this save become Sickened 1 from the numerous painful wounds caused by the swarm.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trip and Tangle
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A creature in the trapjaw tangle's space took damage from the swarm during this round

Effect The trapjaw tangle attempts an athletics|against:fortitude|options:trip-tangle check with a +10 modifier against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature is Off-Guard until the start of the trapjaw tangle's next turn. On a critical success, the creature also falls Prone.
